extras: Does not support conditions, expressions, or executable code; does not change tab captions or rename files.
intentEvidence: Compose Obsidian window titles with a visual builder and an editable template.
problem: Obsidian window titles are static, making it difficult to convey context (like file name or project status) when viewing content outside the note editor.
summary: A visual builder and template system for composing dynamic window titles in Obsidian using vault data and frontmatter properties.
